# The Ed25519 public keys Deadbolt's release signatures are checked against
# (docs/releasing.md, "Signed releases"): one base64 key per line, the raw
# 32 bytes. `deadbolt update` compiles this file in and, once it lists a key,
# refuses any manifest that isn't signed by one of them. The `sign-update`
# job signs with UPDATE_SIGNING_KEY and fails unless that key's public half
# is listed here.
#
# List two during a rotation (current and next), and drop the old one once
# every supported build pins the next.
#
# No key is pinned yet, so releases are unsigned and nothing is checked.
